description: Pronunciation lexicon to SSML phoneme and sub tags — Applies your pronunciation lexicon (up to 200 terms, each an IPA string or a spoken alias) to a text of up to 20000 characters and returns SSML 1.1 with <phoneme alphabet="ipa"> or <sub alias> around each whole-word match, XML-escaped, for an agent preparing text for a text-to-speech engine. Matching is whole-word, longest term first, left to right, deterministic. It does not guess pronunciations,

lang.description: xml:lang of the speak element (default en-US).

name: pronunciation-apply
